title: Schema forms, page editing and input primitives
summary: JSON Forms with schema validation, Puck registered blocks and revision-safe drafts, Radix/React Aria dialog variants, and phone/masked inputs.

profiles: Node 24.19.0 + React/ReactDOM 19.3.0; TypeScript build and six tests covering real JSON Forms/AJV and Puck server rendering, draft conflicts, phone parsing and dialog trigger markup.
notes: React 18 is within upstream peer ranges but was not executed in this pack; no browser drag/drop, mask events, focus, keyboard or screen-reader acceptance was run.
Persistence, revision enforcement, publication authorization and custom block/schema validation belong to the receiving application.
